empty.reason: Static marketing page: content is fixed in code, there is no data source that can be empty.

single.reason: Static marketing page with fixed content lists; no data-driven item count to vary.

many.reason: Lists are fixed editorial content in code, not user data, so they cannot overflow.

loading.reason: Page is rendered statically with no fetch or async state.

edge.reason: Copy is fixed in code; the mobile capture already covers the narrowest layout where long text wraps.

error.reason: Page performs no requests or validation, so there is no failure state to show.

key-interaction.reason: The only actions are in-page anchor links that scroll; the real booking flow is deliberately deferred to a later plan.
